sections.heading: 1. Operator
paragraphs: The operator of the personal data is [SELLER LEGAL NAME, SOLE PROPRIETOR] (INN [INN], OGRNIP [OGRNIP], address: [ADDRESS]), the Operator.
This policy follows Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27.07.2006 "On Personal Data" and is published under Article 18.1 part 2 of that law.
This English text is a translation for convenience. The Russian text prevails.

sections.heading: 2. Data that is processed
paragraphs: Account data: the email address, the name, the password hash, the selected interface language.
Technical data: the IP address and the browser data (user agent) of each sign-in session and of the records of the activity log.
Payment data: the plan, the invoices and payments, the identifier of the saved payment method at the payment service. The Operator does not receive or store full bank card data.
For a sign-in through an external provider (OAuth): the account identifier at the selected provider, the email address and the name.
The Operator does not process special categories of personal data or biometric personal data.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: To conclude and perform the contract with the user: registration, sign-in, the functions of the service, payments, receipts and service notices. The basis is Article 6 part 1 point 5 of Law No. 152-FZ; this purpose needs no separate consent.
To perform the duties that the law sets, such as fiscal receipts and accounting. The basis is Article 6 part 1 point 2 of Law No. 152-FZ.
To protect the accounts and the service from unauthorized access and abuse.
For a purpose outside the contract (for example marketing mail), the data is processed only with a separate consent. No such processing occurs now.

sections.heading: 4. Operations and data location
paragraphs: The Operator collects, records, organizes, accumulates, stores, corrects, retrieves, uses, transfers in the cases of section 5, blocks, deletes and destroys personal data by automated means.
The recording, organization, accumulation, storage, correction and retrieval of the personal data of citizens of the Russian Federation use databases located in the Russian Federation.

sections.heading: 5. Transfer to other persons
paragraphs: To the YooKassa payment service (NBCO YooMoney LLC): the data necessary to make a payment and to issue a fiscal receipt.
To the email provider [NAME]: the email address and the text of the service message.
To the sign-in provider (OAuth) that the user selects: the data necessary for the sign-in.
To state authorities: in the cases that the law of the Russian Federation sets.
No cross-border transfer of personal data occurs.

sections.heading: 6. Storage periods
paragraphs: Account data is processed during the contract and is deleted after the account is deleted, unless the law requires a longer storage.
The records of the activity log are stored for [PERIOD] days. Payment documents are stored for the periods that tax and accounting law set.

sections.heading: 7. Rights of the data subject
paragraphs: The user can get information about the processing of the data, demand its correction, blocking or destruction, withdraw a consent when the processing rests on one, and complain about the Operator to Roskomnadzor or to a court.
A request is sent to the email address [EMAIL]. The Operator answers within the periods of Law No. 152-FZ.

sections.heading: 8. Data protection
paragraphs: The Operator takes the legal, organizational and technical measures of Article 19 of Law No. 152-FZ: encrypted connections, passwords stored as hashes, access control, an activity log, two-factor authentication.

sections.heading: 9. Cookies
paragraphs: The Service uses only the cookies necessary for the sign-in and the security of the session. It uses no advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: 10. Changes
paragraphs: The Operator publishes a new version of the policy on this page. The date of the version is at the top of the document.
